positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
• Full-stack engineer on the Growth Marketing team, building and maintaining Mindbody’s B2B marketing platform.
• Technical lead for the primary marketing website, the top lead-generation channel for a $268M/year business.
• Drove measurable business impact, contributing to +17% CVR, +22% MQLs, and +38% closed-won revenue (2025 vs. 2024).
• Implement conversion rate optimization experiments and personalization campaigns using Optimizely.
• Led development of Mindbody’s web patterns library—a component-based system enabling non-technical teams to create and manage custom pages independently.
• Developed a custom company job board integrated with the Greenhouse API.
• Established CI/CD pipelines and automated test coverage using GitHub Actions and Playwright to improve release confidence and velocity.
• Embed SEO, performance, accessibility, privacy, security, UX, and analytics best practices into all development work.
• Serve as the primary technical point of contact for CMS users.
• Selected to participate in the Mindbody Leadership Development Program, with training in job coaching, effective meeting management, and change management.
• Mentor junior and aspiring engineers through the Mindbody mentoring program; support hiring through interviews, onboarding, and team mentorship.

Technologies:
JavaScript (ES6), PHP, Drupal 7–10, HTML, SASS/SCSS, Git, GitHub Actions, Playwright, Behat, Optimizely, Tealium, New Relic, Braze, Figma, Cursor

positions.title: Web Technical Manager, National Zoo
positions.description:
Manage web development at the Smithsonian's National Zoo and Conservation Biology Institute.

Accomplishments include:

•	Technical lead on a project to rebuild the National Zoo's website.
•	Developed Drupal module that integrates with Smithsonian Libraries to automatically populate Smithsonian units' scientist webpages with their publications.
•	Built visitor access system for the Smithsonian Conservation Biology Institute.
•	Built daily reporting system for animal keepers.
•	Built collaborative system for tracking progress towards meeting Smithsonian Conservation Biology Institute strategic goals.
•	Built Zoo/SCBI Intranet website using Drupal 7 and Organic Groups.
•	Developed automated “upsell system” for Friends of the National Zoo membership sales, resulting in an estimated $25,000 per year in extra revenue.
•	Launched first fully WCAG 2.0 AA compliant Smithsonian website.
•	Developed custom Drupal 7 modules that integrate with external APIs to keep the Zoo's website data up-to-date (e.g. animal data is synced with International Union for Conservation data).
•	Developed emergency messaging system.

Other responsibilities include:

•	Requirements gathering
•	Content structure development
•	Site building
•	Custom module development
•	Ensuring accessibility compliance

positions.title: Project Manager, U.S. Army Office of Small Business Programs
positions.description:
•	Manage a team of three people on a contract providing website development/maintenance, graphic design, outreach, data analysis, and administrative support to a high‐level Army office
•	Ensure compliance with Army website regulations including section 508
•	Manage subcontractors and vendors
•	Assist Halfaker business development by writing and reviewing proposals
•	Employed skills and technology: Project planning/scheduling, proposal writing, contract negotiation and execution

positions.title: Data Analyst / Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Employee of the Quarter, first quarter 2011 for “demonstrating company culture and superior performance”
•	Develop and maintain several Drupal-based Army OSBP web applications
•	Led the development of, and currently manage, Army OSBP’s social media presence
•	Perform statistical and performance analysis of the Army Small Business Program in support of Army policy formulation
•	Help small businesses navigate federal contracting through phone calls and one-on-one meetings
•	Assist Halfaker business development by writing and reviewing proposals

honors.title: 3rd place, Nucleate NY Biohackathon
honors.description:
Built an AI agent that turns a plain-English device description into a structured FDA 510(k) submission draft — complete with predicate search across 200k+ cleared devices, eSTAR field drafting, and XML export — in under a minute. Uses LangGraph, Nebius LLMs, SQLite FTS, and Streamlit.

https://github.com/antmbraun/NextGen-BioAgents-Hackathon-2026
